releaseWarrant: Material central-account and cross-portal distribution foundation: eliminates the requirement for a prebuilt claimable profile while preventing duplicate public profiles and payment-based publication.

improvements.benefit: Attorneys can enter and maintain authoritative information once.
An attorney can build a private profile even when Smarter Justice has not seeded one.
Roger can manually create and link a private professional or firm workspace to an existing account.
Focused portals can consume controlled read-only profile and firm payloads under one contract.
Public specialty profiles remain on focused portals rather than being duplicated centrally.
Membership payment cannot bypass credential, evidence, assignment, or publication review.

ownerBenefit: The attorney launch funnel is clearer, safer, and harder to misconfigure or underbill while every commercial gate remains explicit.
publicUserBenefit: Professionals can create accounts and manage accurate profiles more easily without any implication that payment buys verification, ranking, or clients.
